title: Summarizing and reviewing lessons

body.text: The most effective review technique with AI:
active recall — have the AI quiz you on what you studied, instead of re-reading
— upload your slides or notes and have it create questions, flashcards, or a mock exam.

example: "From this chapter's slides, create 10 questions, ask one at a time, give the answer with an explanation after I respond, and keep the ones I get wrong to ask again"

title: The Feynman technique with AI

body.text: A way to prove you truly understand:
explain the topic to the AI in your own words, then have it catch where you're still misunderstanding
— if you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough yet.

example: "I'll explain photosynthesis as I understand it; listen and point out what's wrong or missing: '...'"
